# Earlier V2 event-project fixture

`studio-v3-event-world.excogitare` was generated with the committed schema-3 implementation before its fictional-event programme was removed. It contains 960 tiles, a former flood operation followed by a moisture edit, one protected tile, a protected river, an earlier snapshot and separate Create/Develop drafts. The accepted map differs from its original native surface on 203 tiles.

The migration test reads the actual earlier archive and compares its accepted map, physical fields, author-written metadata, protection, snapshot and drafts with the migrated project. It also checks subsequent physical editing and export. The old event programme and native foundation remain archived, so keeping the map does not require retaining the programme as an active generation mechanism.

This is a synthetic compatibility fixture, not a user map or a claim about an actual geological history.
